original_test_intent: Verify the live POST ESC hint and keyboard path work, the displayed BIOS version/release date are correct/readable and ESC enters BIOS setup without changing settings.
original_method: An authorized operator reboots the exact SUT, records the POST screen, presses ESC within the approved hint window, captures successful setup entry, then exits without saving and restores the normal boot state.
manual_activity: An authorized operator must see the live POST display, press ESC in the correct pre-OS window, confirm BIOS setup visually and exit without saving; the agent can only package corroborating data.
required_inputs: Exact SUT and expected BIOS version/build/release date
Expected POST ESC hint wording, display phase and timing window
Approved reboot/workload window and boot deadline
Qualified operator with correct physical console or authenticated KVM keyboard path
Timestamped screen capture policy and evidence retention
No-save exit path and independent recovery for missed/failed POST entry
safety_requirements: Require approval before reboot and interrupting workloads
Verify console/KVM target identity before sending ESC
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL
Do not change or save BIOS settings
Stop on wrong target, unexpected firmware prompt, boot loop or ambiguous key response
No repeated reboot/key attempts without operator review
agent_execution_scope: Verify approved expected values and target identity
Collect read-only baseline/post-boot BIOS/SUT health corroboration
Verify no-save exit and restored reachability from provided evidence
Make no pre-OS keypress claim, firmware mutation, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve reboot, expected POST/BIOS values, console path and recovery
Perform or supervise ESC keypress and visual capture
Review readability, timing, menu entry/no-save exit and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No SSH command can execute or prove the live pre-OS keyboard/display path; DeepSeek's NO assessment is correct.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use no software command as a substitute. Read-only inventory/logs may corroborate exact BIOS identity after the operator's captured action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ESC hotkey, live POST hint, BIOS version/release date, setup entry, photos, Manual nature and 30/30-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL ONLY LIVE POST ESC PATH VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a continuous or timestamp-linked sequence showing exact target identity, visible POST/version/date/hint, ESC key actuation response, BIOS setup screen, exit-without-save and normal boot recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact timing, no-save/recovery and evidence-chain requirements while preserving the physical pre-OS action.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Inventory or POST logs can confirm a BIOS version or code but bypass the display readability, keyboard path, hint timing and setup-navigation behavior under test.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote KVM may inject keys through a path different from a physical keyboard; its use must be approved as representative for this platform and documented.

project_override_considerations: A project-specific KVM, POST timing or alternate setup hotkey may be used only if explicitly approved for this exact SUT; it cannot silently replace ESC coverage.
expected_evidence: Verified SUT/BIOS identity, expected version/date/hint and reboot approval
Timestamped live POST screen and ESC action window
Readable BIOS version/release date and BIOS setup entry screen
Preserved logs, no BIOS change/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and both prior reviews consistently require a live ESC keypress and visual BIOS setup entry. Missing exact timing/value inputs are readiness gaps.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The agent cannot perform the physical/pre-OS action, but an authorized operator can; MANUAL ONLY is correct rather than global BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Retains the defining live ESC interaction and makes the evidence chain distinguish display, keyboard, menu and recovery coverage from software inventory.
independent_technical_reasoning: A correct BIOS version in SMBIOS and a POST-code trace do not exercise the keyboard controller or firmware hotkey dispatcher. The key must be accepted during a narrow live phase, and the resulting setup screen must be visually distinguished from a boot menu or recovery page. Because entering setup exposes mutable settings, exit-without-save evidence is part of the safe completion boundary.
